formulas.ascii: z_i = sum_j w_ij c_j / (S sqrt(Delta_i)); Delta_i = (n S1_i - W_i^2)/(n-1); W_i = sum_j w_ij + w_ii; S1_i = sum_j w_ij^2 + w_ii^2; c_j = x_j - mean; j runs over active neighbors, w_ii = selfWeight (1 = Gi*). S is the population standard deviation of the n analysis rows. Row-standardized weights are re-divided by what remains of the row sum. With selfWeight = 0 (Gi) the mean and variance of the n-1 other rows replace X and S^2. NaN when n < 2, S = 0, n S1_i <= W_i^2 or fewer than minimumNeighbors neighbors. Two-sided normal p-value; bins use p (or the adjusted p) at 0.10, 0.05, 0.01.
